briefdescription.para: This method will be invoked for all target nodes and for any target-independent nodes that the target has registered with invoke it for.

detaileddescription.para: The semantics are as follows: Return Value: SDValue.Val == 0 - No change was made SDValue.Val == N - N was replaced, is dead, and is already handled. otherwise - N should be replaced by the returned Operand.
In addition, methods provided by DAGCombinerInfo may be used to perform more complex transformations.
